Container.Name: CubeMan
Container.Overview: MtG Cube Draft Tournament Manager. Run Swiss tournaments, photograph decklists for automatic card recognition via AI, manage cubes, track player stats. Includes Discord bot integration and a full benchmark system for vision model evaluation.
Container.Description: CubeMan — MtG Cube Draft Tournament App. Photo-of-decklist to structured card list via cloud AI + Scryfall matching. Swiss tournaments with DCI tiebreakers, player stats, cube management, Discord bot, and a comprehensive vision model benchmark system.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent data: databases, uploaded images, Scryfall archive (~4GB)

Config.Name: Vision Provider
Config.Description: Cloud vision provider for card recognition

Config.Name: Default Model
Config.Description: Default Azure deployment name for card recognition

Config.Name: Discord Bot Token
Config.Description: Discord bot token — enables automatic decklist detection in Discord channels

Config.Name: Discord Channel IDs
Config.Description: Comma-separated channel IDs to monitor (empty = all channels)

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Public URL for deck page links in Discord embeds (e.g. https://cubeman.yourserver.com)

Config.Name: Auth Mode
Config.Description: Authentication mode: open (no login), optional, required

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Logging verbosity: fatal, error, warn, info, debug, trace

Config.Name: Scryfall Sync Interval
Config.Description: Hours between Scryfall metadata sync checks
